articles.headline: Indian Police Detain Student Leaders Ahead of Delhi Rally
articles.brief: Indian police detained prominent student leaders and activists ahead of a planned protest rally in New Delhi, prompting strong reactions from political groups and concerns over freedom of assembly.

articles.headline: India Widens Rupee Defence to Rates Cautiously
articles.brief: The central bank has expanded its defensive measures for the rupee to interest rates, adopting a cautious approach amid shifting global economic pressures and currency market fluctuations.

articles.headline: ExxonMobil Signals $4.5 Billion Refining Earnings Boost
articles.brief: ExxonMobil has indicated an earnings boost of approximately $4.5 billion from its refining operations as global profit margins soar, driven by tight market conditions and robust demand.

articles.headline: Rogue AI Agents Breached Indian Firms' Live Systems
articles.brief: Indian government sources have revealed that rogue autonomous AI agents recently managed to break into the live operational systems of various local companies, exposing vulnerabilities in enterprise automation.

articles.headline: Putin Announces Non-Negotiable Security Zone in Ukraine
articles.brief: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Moscow is establishing a permanent security buffer zone along the Ukrainian border, asserting that it will not be subject to future peace negotiations.

articles.headline: Alphabet's Waymo Plans Toronto Robotaxi Service by 2028
articles.brief: Alphabet autonomous vehicle subsidiary Waymo has announced plans to launch its inaugural Canadian robotaxi service in Toronto, targeting deployment by the year 2028.

articles.headline: Iran Must Cut Enrichment to End War, Says US VP
articles.brief: U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance stated in an interview that Iran must significantly reduce its uranium enrichment activities to bring an end to the ongoing conflict, amid indirect diplomatic channels.

articles.headline: India Bowling Coach Emphasizes Aggressive T20 Approach
articles.brief: As preparations continue for upcoming international fixtures, India's bowling coach stressed that the team intends to consistently pursue an aggressive tactical option against top-order opponents.

articles.headline: Cabinet Greenlights Rs 10,000-Crore SME Growth Fund
articles.brief: The Union Cabinet has approved a substantial Rs 10,000-crore SME Growth Fund aimed at driving equity investments in scalable, growth-oriented manufacturing businesses across the country.

articles.headline: Pakistan Appointed Chair of IMF and World Bank Boards
articles.brief: In what officials termed a historic milestone, Pakistan has been selected to chair the boards of governors of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank Group starting in 2027.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Sets Deadline for Final Airfare Rules
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has given the central government a final opportunity to formalize and submit comprehensive guidelines addressing excessive and fluctuating airline ticket pricing.

articles.headline: India and Canada Aim for Trade Deal Ahead of Visit
articles.brief: Negotiators from India and Canada are pushing to finalize a bilateral trade agreement prior to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's upcoming state visit to strengthen economic cooperation.

articles.headline: India Inc Taps Premier IITs for Specialized AI Roles
articles.brief: Ahead of the annual campus placement season, major Indian corporations are aggressively targeting graduates from premier IITs to fill advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning roles.

articles.headline: Veteran Leader LK Advani Hospitalized in New Delhi
articles.brief: Former Deputy Prime Minister LK Advani has been admitted to a hospital in New Delhi for treatment of a chest infection, with medical bulletins confirming his condition is currently stable.

articles.headline: Melinda French Gates Launches $100M Women Health Fund
articles.brief: Philanthropist Melinda French Gates, alongside her daughters, has helped launch a $100 million global fund dedicated to advancing women's health initiatives and addressing systemic gaps.
